verdict.rationale: Account two-factor authentication is a fair question for a hosted developer platform like GitHub, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions 2FA, TOTP, or authenticator apps. The authentication evidence covers only adjacent features (SSH keys, fine-grained personal access tokens, Google/Apple social login, gh auth login), and these earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my account with two-factor authentication using a TOTP authenticator app
